title: From the Ground Up
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This article is about the [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}. For the [[Quest]] in {{AoC}}, see "[[From the Ground Up (Age of Calamity)|From the Ground Up]]".}} {{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW From the Ground Up.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Hudson]] |location= Hateno Village |prereq= |reward= [[Tarrey Town]]
{{Icon List|BotW| * Diamond {{Qty|3}} }} |previous= {{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[Hylian Homeowner]]}} |next= {{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[A Parent's Love]]}}'''"
"'''{{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[Hobbies of the Rich]]}} }} "{{Term/Store|From the Ground Up||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|From the Ground Up}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Hateno Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== "From the Ground Up" can be started after the completion of the "[[Hylian Homeowner]]" [[Side Quest]] in [[Hateno Village]]. [[Link]] must speak to Hudson after purchasing [[Link's House|his house]]. During their conversation, Hudson informs Link that he will be leaving soon,{{Cite|Looks like I've gotta head out and leave this place soon.|Hudson|BotW}} since he has been transferred.{{Cite|[Why?] I've been transferred.|Hudson|BotW}} [[Bolson Construction]] is planning expansions,{{Cite|Mighta heard, but Bolson Construction is planning to expand big-time.|Hudson|BotW}} specifically in the [[Akkala]] [[Region]].{{Cite|[Where will you go?] Zora's Domain is north of here. We're going north of that, though. An area called the {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala region}}.|Hudson|BotW}} When Link wishes him luck, Hudson stands and decides to leave right then.{{Cite|[Good luck!] OK then. Well... No time like the present, right? I should be getting on my way...|Hudson|BotW}} He invites Link to come visit him,{{Cite|If you'd like, you should come to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala region}} and say hello.|Hudson|BotW}} before telling him to take care and setting off.{{Cite|Well... Take care of yourself.|Hudson|BotW}} Afterwards, Hudson can be found on the rocky island in the middle of [[Lake Akkala]].{{Cite|Hey. We meet again.|Hudson|BotW}} When Link does not recognize him, Hudson will reintroduce himself.{{Cite|[Who are you again?] I'm one of the Bolson Construction contractors. The name's Hudson.|Hudson|BotW}} Since his transfer, Hudson has decided to create an entire village,{{Cite|Since I've been transferred here, I've decided to build a village from scratch.|Hudson|BotW}} which he will call [[Tarrey Town]].{{Cite|Every village needs a name, though. I think I'll call it...{{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}}.|Hudson|BotW}} However, Hudson is lacking in both supplies and manpower to make a village.{{Cite|I built a house to store the village supplies in, but there just isn't enough... [Enough what?] Enough anything... People... Money... Stuff...|Hudson|BotW}} If Link offers to help him, Hudson asks what is in it for him.{{Cite|[I'll help out!] But why? There's nothing in it for you.|Hudson|BotW}} When Link insists that he does not mind, Hudson says that he is a lifesaver.{{Cite|[I don't mind!] You're a lifesaver...|Hudson|BotW}} In order to build more houses, Hudson asks for 10 bundles of [[Wood]].{{Cite|Well...I suppose to get started, we'll need houses for people to live in. We can't invite them until we have homes. Do you think you can bring me {{Color BotW|Red|10 bundles of wood}}? If you bring me that, I can combine it with what I've already got and get started on new houses.|Hudson|BotW}} Once Link has acquired the 10 bundles of Wood, he can speak to Hudson again to give them to him.{{Cite|[I brought them!] Excellent! Can I have them? [Sure!] You're a lifesaver...|Hudson|BotW}} Next, Hudson admits that he is having a difficult time clearing out the boulders.{{Cite|These boulders are driving me nuts. I want to move them out of the way so we can develop the land underneath.|Hudson|BotW}} He asks Link to find someone with "brute physical strength",{{Cite|It'd really help me if you could find someone with enough {{Color BotW|Red|brute physical strength}} to bust them apart.|Hudson|BotW}} such as a [[Goron]].{{Cite|[Physical strength?] Yeah, if we're talking about {{Color BotW|Red|brute physical strength}}, and we are, a {{Color BotW|Red|Goron}} would be my first choice...|Hudson|BotW}} Since it seems like a longshot, he wishes Link luck.{{Cite|Good luck! You'll need it... This seems like a real long shot.|Hudson|BotW}} Before he leaves, Hudson informs Link that their name must end with "son", in accordance to Bolson Construction policy.{{Cite|Oh, and one last wrinkle... Yeah, in accordance with the official {{Color BotW|Blue|Bolson Construction}} policy, that someone's name must end in "son."|Hudson|BotW}} Link can find the Goron, [[Greyson]], at the [[Southern Mine]] in the [[Eldin Canyon]]. Greyson is sick of digging at the Mine every day, as he receives no recognition.{{Cite|I'm a digger here, as you can see. I dig and I dig... Day in and day out... To be honest, I'm sick of it. I feel like...maybe I'm not meant to toil away in obscurity like this. *sigh*|Greyson|BotW}} He wants to use his strength to make a difference somewhere, if it is possible.{{Cite|Is there a job out there for me that'd let me use my {{Color BotW|Red|strength}} to make a difference?|Greyson|BotW}} When Link tells him that there is such a place, Greyson is interested and asks to hear more.{{Cite|[There is.] Huh? There is? Where? Please, tell me more!|Greyson|BotW}} Though Greyson has never heard of Tarrey Town before,{{Cite|[Tarrey Town.] Tarrey Town? Never heard of it. What's the deal with that place?|Greyson|BotW}} he decides to take a chance.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}}... So there is somewhere out there that needs me... Hmm, {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala}} isn't too far from here. All right! I'm gonna do it! I'm gonna strike while the iron is hot!|Greyson|BotW}} He takes his little brother [[Pelison]] with him, and the pair leave the Southern Mine together.{{Cite|Thanks for lettin' me know, brother! Pelison and I are gonna head there right away! While I'm at it... {{Big|Pelison! We're gonna leave!}}|Greyson|BotW}}{{Cite|Hm?|Pelison|BotW}} Once they have left, Link can return to Tarrey Town. Hudson is grateful that he was able to find Gorons to help him,{{Cite|Hey. You sent some Gorons back here. That's perfect. The strength of a Goron is undeniable.|Hudson|BotW}} and he is pleased that their names abide by Bolson Construction policies.{{Cite|Those boulders don't stand a chance against them... And with names like Greyson and Pelison, they'll fit right in.|Hudson|BotW}} He also informs Link that Pelison set up [[Ore and More]] to sell the ore found within the boulders.{{Cite|Also, Pelison started selling the {{Color BotW|Blue|ore}} found within the boulders. You should go say hello again.|Hudson|BotW}} For his next task, Hudson requests 20 bundles of Wood for further construction on houses.{{Cite|So before more people can move here, we need homes for them to live in. Can you bring me {{Color BotW|Red|20 bundles of wood}}?|Hudson|BotW}} After they have been delivered, Hudson notes that his clothes have become worn and asks for Link to find a tailor.{{Cite|Working such long hours every day really wears on my clothes. Could you look for {{Color BotW|Red|someone who's got a gift for tailoring}} for me?|Hudson|BotW}} He suggests looking among the [[Gerudo]] for such an individual.{{Cite|[Tailoring?] If we're talking about {{Color BotW|Red|tailoring}}... there could be someone among the {{Color BotW|Red|Gerudo}} who's good at that.|Hudson|BotW}} Once again, he reminds Link of the Bolson Construction naming policy. At [[Kara Kara Bazaar]], Link can find [[Rhondson]] sitting outside of the [[Kara Kara Bazaar Inn]].{{Cite|Oh, yes, I'm Rhondson. I hail from Gerudo Town.|Rhondson|BotW}} She has become exhausted by her search for a husband,{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|search for the love of my life}}... I'm so exhausted by it.|Rhondson|BotW}} as no man she has met was able to appreciate a well-hemmed garment.{{Cite|I've proven myself a gifted tailor, but none of the voe I've met seem to appreciate a well-hemmed garment.|Rhondson|BotW}} In addition, there is not much demand for a tailor in the area.{{Cite|I was hoping my craft would help me find a mate, but it doesn't seem like there's much work for a tailor around here.|Rhondson|BotW}} She wonders if there could truly be someone for her out there.{{Cite|I wonder if there really is someone out there for me...|Rhondson|BotW}} When Link suggests she go to Tarrey Town, Rhondson asks to hear the details.{{Cite|[Go to Tarrey Town!] Eh? What is it? So abrupt, too... Let me hear the details.|Rhondson|BotW}} Despite its distance from [[Gerudo Town]], Rhondson believes that she may need to travel to find herself a man.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala region}} is kinda far away. But maybe I need to travel. Getting far away from a village full of vai...|Rhondson|BotW}} She decides to start the journey so she can continue her search.{{Cite|But it's not like I'm accomplishing anything by staying here. I can continue my search in {{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}}.|Rhondson|BotW}} She thanks Link for the tip, before heading back home to pack her bag.{{Cite|Thanks for all the information. I'm gonna go home and pack a huge bag. It'll be a long journey all the way there... I'll no doubt see you again in {{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}}|Rhondson|BotW}} After recruiting Rhondson, Link must travel back to Tarrey Town. Hudson is grateful that Link managed to find someone who fit his requirements.{{Cite|Hey. You found someone from the Gerudo. Thank you.|Hudson|BotW}} He expresses admiration for Rhondson, as she patched up every hole in his clothes,{{Cite|She was able to patch every last hole in my work clothes before I could blink. She's pretty...er, amazing!|Hudson|BotW}} in addition to the fact that he name matches the naming policy.{{Cite|And since her name is Rhondson, I have no objections.|Hudson|BotW}} Since her arrival, Rhondson has opened the [[Rhondson Armor Boutique]] to continue selling her clothing.{{Cite|I hear she's decided to continue putting her skills to use by opening a {{Color BotW|Blue|clothing shop}}. You should stop by and say hello.|Hudson|BotW}} Next, Hudson requests that Link bring him 30 bundles of Wood.{{Cite|So before people can move here, we need more homes for them to live in. Can you bring me {{Color BotW|Red|30 bundles of wood}}?|Hudson|BotW}} Once this Wood has been delivered back to Hudson, he will share that Tarrey Town is starting to look like a town, and therefore needs a [[General Store]].{{Cite|It's finally starting to look like a town around here. Which is exactly why we need to set up some distribution. I'd like to get a general store up and running, but there's no one with the connections and qualifications to run it.|Hudson|BotW}} Therefore, he asks Link to keep an eye out for someone who would know about running a General Store.{{Cite|Do you think you could keep an eye out for someone who knows about {{Color BotW|Red|distribution}} and {{Color BotW|Red|can run a general store}}?|Hudson|BotW}} When Link suggests a traveling trader, Hudson says that a [[Rito]] may be able to fill such a role.{{Cite|[So a traveling trader?] Oh, that's a good thought... {{Color BotW|Red|Rito}} can fly around, so they should be able to retrieve and deliver supplies.|Hudson|BotW}} He also reminds Link of the Bolson Construction naming policy once again. In [[Rito Village]], Link can encounter [[Fyson]], who has troubles aside from [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]].{{Cite|Hey, what's up? So, have you seen it? {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Medoh}}? Everyone in the village is freaking out because of it, but I have bigger problems...|Fyson|BotW}}{{Cite|I'm glad {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}} has settled down, but I have bigger problems.|Fyson|BotW}} His mother, [[Misa]], wants him to take over [[The Slippery Falcon]] somday,{{Cite|My mom said she wants me to take over the family store someday... Can you believe that?!|Fyson|BotW}} but he wants to open his own store instead.{{Cite|I don't...want to just "help." I want to open my OWN store and sell whatever I want!|Fyson|BotW}} However, he does not want to compete with his mother's business, and so he wishes to find somewhere else to set up his shop.{{Cite|But I don't want to compete with Mom. I wish there was a place I could set up my own shop...|Fyson|BotW}} When Link tells Fyson about Tarrey Town, he is intrigued and asks to hear more.{{Cite|[Heard of Tarrey Town?] {{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}}? Tell me more.|Fyson|BotW}} Though he is excited to hear that they need a General Store,{{Cite|Oh! So they're in need of a general store. That's perfect!|Fyson|BotW}} he is a bit worried about traveling to Akkala.{{Cite|But the {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala region}}? That's pretty far out there.|Fyson|BotW}} He reasons that he needs to leave the nest to open his own store,{{Cite|{{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|But I guess I've got to leave the nest someday. And to have my own store...}}}}|Fyson|BotW}} and so he decides to head out.{{Cite|OK... I made up my mind! I'm going!|Fyson|BotW}} On his way to Tarrey Town, he plans on gathering [[Item]]s to sell at his new shop.{{Cite|I know! I'll gather some items on the way to {{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}} and then sell them at my new shop...|Fyson|BotW}} He thanks Link for the suggestion and invites him to come visit.{{Cite|Thanks for the tip! And hey, don't be a stranger. Come visit me at my new home sometime!|Fyson|BotW}} Back at Tarrey Town, Hudson thanks Link for finding a Rito.{{Cite|You managed to find a Rito and bring him back here. Thank you.|Hudson|BotW}} Fyson has already set up the [[Slippery Falcon (Tarrey Town Branch)]],{{Cite|He wasted no time getting a general store up and running—apparently his family runs one too.|Hudson|BotW}} and Hudson approves of his name.{{Cite|And with a name like Fyson, he'll fit right in!|Hudson|BotW}} Hudson encourages Link to check out the store.{{Cite|He's selling things that he's picked up while flying around. You should really go check out the store.|Hudson|BotW}} Next, Hudson asks Link to bring him 50 bundles of Wood to make more houses.{{Cite|So before we can call more people here, we need even more homes for them. Can you bring me {{Color BotW|Red|50 bundles of wood}}?|Hudson|BotW}} Upon returning to Tarrey Town with the Wood, Hudson tells Link that he wants to share something personal.{{Cite|I actually wanted to talk about something a little personal...|Hudson|BotW}} He confesses to Link that he has gotten engaged to Rhondson.{{Cite|[What's wrong?] Oh, not that kind of personal. Actually, I got engaged.|Hudson|BotW}}{{Cite|[To who?] To Rhondson.|Hudson|BotW}} To this end, he needs someone priest-like to officiate.{{Cite|Anyway, we want to have a little ceremony to celebrate, but we need someone priest-like to officiate. Could you look for someone {{Color BotW|Red|priest-like}} for us?|Hudson|BotW}} He suggests looking among the [[Zora]] for such a person.{{Cite|If we're looking for a people devout enough to have a {{Color BotW|Red|priest-like person}}...I'd suggest the {{Color BotW|Red|Zora}}.|Hudson|BotW}} For the final time, Hudson will remind Link of the naming policies of Bolson Construction. In [[Zora's Domain]], Link can encounter the Zora, [[Kapson]]. Due to his advanced age,{{Cite|Spending day after day in idleness only to pass from this world soon... Link... As I'm sure you are well aware, the afterlife lays claim to all. We never know when it will beckon.|Kapson|BotW}} Kapson would like one last opportunity to wed an engaged couple.{{Cite|If during your travels you meet any {{Color BotW|Red|engaged couples}}, I would like you to introduce them to me. Joining two souls is a true honor, one I shall stake my life on. Just one more wedding...and I shall be fulfilled.|Kapson|BotW}} If Link shares the news of Hudson and Rhondson's upcoming wedding,{{Cite|[Get a load of this...] I have been waiting to hear those words. Now, please tell me the specifics...|Kapson|BotW}} he expresses a desire to get there as quickly as possible.{{Cite|As for the location... Hmmm... {{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}} in {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala}}... {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala}} isn't too far from here. It would please me to hurry there right away.|Kapson|BotW}} He is confident in his ability to make it to Tarrey Town on his own.{{Cite|[By yourself?] No need to worry about me. I have always had confidence in my fins and feet!|Kapson|BotW}} Kapson leaves Zora's Domain, and he asks Link to come attend the wedding.{{Cite|It has been a long while since I have had work. I am eager to put my skills to good use! You should come as well. I will start my preparations in {{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}} in the meantime.|Kapson|BotW}} When Link returns to Tarrey Town, the construction of the village will finally be complete. Hudson thanks Link for finding a Zora priest with a name that abides by the Bolson Construction policies.{{Cite|You found a Zora? Thank you...really. He and I talked earlier, and he said that he literally was a priest before he retired. You can't get more priest-like than that. And his name is Kapson, so I have no objections there. It really is amazing that you were able to find someone priest-like who also had an acceptable name.|Hudson|BotW}} For the wedding ceremony, Hudson would like Link to invite [[Bolson]] and [[Karson]] to Tarrey Town.{{Cite|Of course, we'll have to invite guests in order to hold a ceremony... [Guests?] Well, I'm talking about my boss, Bolson, and my subordinate, Karson. [I see.] However, I've got to prepare for the ceremony, so my hands are full... Could you invite them for me?|Hudson|BotW}} At Hateno Village, Link can inform Bolson and Karson of the upcoming event.{{Cite|Wait. What? {{Big|Hudson's getting married?!}} And he wants me to attend the wedding? ...Wow, good on him.|Bolson|BotW}} Bolson decides to attend, as he does not have much to do in Hateno.{{Cite|Okey-doo, I'm in. Wedding time, baby! Not like there's anything to do here, anyway...|Bolson|BotW}} He beckons for Karson to follow him,{{Cite|{{Big|Karson, we're headed out!}}|Bolson|BotW}}{{Cite|Finally! We've been waiting for this day!|Karson|BotW}} and the pair make their way to Tarrey Town. Once the two have arrived in Tarrey Town,{{Cite|You extended my invitation for me. Thank you.|Hudson|BotW}} Hudson asks Link if he is ready for the wedding to begin.{{Cite|Now then, Karson and the boss Bolson are waiting for things to begin... Shall we start the ceremony?|Hudson|BotW}} When Link agrees to start the wedding, he is transported behind Hudson and Rhondson as the pair stand in front of Kapson and the [[Goddess Statue]]. Kapson begins the ceremony.{{Cite|Silence please, everyone. We shall now begin. We are gathered here today to join Hudson and Rhondson in matrimony.|Kapson|BotW}} He asks Hudson if he will take Rhondson to be his wife,{{Cite|Hudson... Before the eyes of these witnesses and before those of Goddess Hylia... Do you take Rhondson to be your wife, to have and to hold, in good times and in bad?|Kapson|BotW}} which he accepts.{{Cite|I do.|Hudson|BotW}} Kapson asks the same question of Rhondson,{{Cite|And Rhondson... Before the eyes of these witnesses and before those of Goddess Hylia... Do you take Hudson as your lawfully wedded husband, in sickness and in health?|Rhondson|BotW}} but he adds on the promise to name any of their children in accordance with the Bolson Construction naming policies.{{Cite|And do you also vow to...name your children in accordance with the Bolson construction naming guidelines?|Kapson|BotW}} Rhondson objects, claiming that these vows are untraditional.{{Cite|Wait a moment... Those vows are not traditional by anyone's standards!|Rhondson|BotW}} Hudson however, is confused by her statement,{{Cite|What makes you say that?|Hudson|BotW}} and Bolson stands to defend the policy.{{Cite|They're as traditional as it gets!|Bolson|BotW}} Karson tries to talk Bolson down by explaining she meant a different kind of tradition,{{Cite|I don't think she means traditional in that sense of the word.|Karson|BotW}} but the rest of the Tarrey Town residents soon stand up in honor of it.{{Cite|A vow of undying tradition!|Fyson|BotW}}{{Cite|And a vow of guidelines compliance!|Pelison|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|I'll take that vow!}}|Greyson|BotW}} Hudson joins in,{{Cite|Think of future generations!|Hudson|BotW}} and so Rhondson agrees.{{Cite|... {{Small|Well, those are the guidelines...}} I do.|Rhondson|BotW}} Kapson declares the couple married and asks the town to join in celebrating them.{{Cite|And so, dearly beloved, please help me in greeting this newly married couple. I wish this new couple nothing but the utmost happiness as they set out on this journey of marital bliss!|Kapson|BotW}} After the wedding, Hudson will begin to cry as he thanks Link for attending.{{Cite|Thank you for attending the ceremony. {{Small|...*sniff*}}|Hudson|BotW}} He remarks that Tarrey Town finally looks like a real town.{{Cite|And now {{Color BotW|Blue|Tarrey Town}} looks like a real town at long last.|Hudson|BotW}} To thank Link for everything he has done, Hudson gives him three [[Diamond]]s,{{Cite|This was all possible because of you. I can't thank you enough for all the hard work you did. All right, this is for you.|Hudson|BotW}} which were found in the boulders while clearing the land.{{Cite|These were found inside the boulders we smashed when we were clearing the land.|Hudson|BotW}}{{Note|If Link's Diamond [[Inventory]] is full, Hudson will hold onto his Diamonds until he can take them.{{Cite|Well, I want to give them to you, but it looks like you haven't got room for {{Color BotW|Red|three}} {{Color BotW|Blue|diamonds}}.|Hudson|BotW}}}} With this, the Side Quest is completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Hudson, Bolson Construction's veteran carpenter, has departed for the {{Color BotW|Red|Akkala}} region to expand the business.

Akkala is far to the north of Hateno Village. If you happen to be passing by, stop in and pay {{Color BotW|Red|Hudson}} a visit. |- | 2 | You bumped into Hudson in the Akkala region, and it sounds like he plans on building a town as part of Bolson Construction's expanison. He even has a name picked out—it will be known as Tarrey Town. That said, he is missing a few things required to make a town.

You know, small things—like lumber.

Bring him {{Color BotW|Red|10 bundles of wood}} to get him started. |- | 3 | You brought Hudson enough wood to get him started, but now he needs to break the boulders scattered across the future site of Tarrey Town. He's asked you to find a {{Color BotW|Red|Goron}} strong enough to help out.

According to the Bolson Construction hiring guidelines, you need to seek out a {{Color BotW|Red|Goron whose name ends in "son."}} The guidelines are unusually specific about this. |- | 4 | Greyson the Goron has moved to Tarrey Town, and his younger brother Pelison tagged along for the ride.

Pay the town a visit to make sure they arrived safely, and check in with {{Color BotW|Red|Hudson}} while you're there. |- | 5 | Greyson and Pelison arrived safely in Tarrey Town and got right to work. Greyson is breaking apart the boulders, and Pelison is selling the ore they find within.

Hudson wants to build some more buildings, but he needs more material. {{Color BotW|Red|Twenty bundles of wood}} should hold him over for this next bunch of buildings. |- | 6 | You delivered more wood to Hudson.

But now he needs someone who can mend his work clothes. He wants you to find a {{Color BotW|Red|Gerudo}} skilled at sewing, but remember the stipulation in the Bolson Construction hiring guidelines: {{Color BotW|Red|the Gerudo's name must end in "son."}} |- | 7 | A Gerudo by the name of Rhondson has moved to Tarrey Town.

Pay the town a visit to make sure she arrived safely. Check in with {{Color BotW|Red|Hudson}} while you're there. |- | 8 | Rhondson arrived safely in Tarrey Town and got right to work. She is not only mending work clothes—she also opened up an armor shop!

Hudson wants to build more buildings, but he's run out of materials once again.

Another {{Color BotW|Red|30 bundles of wood}} should cover him for now. |- | 9 | You brought Hudson more wood.

His next goal is to open up a general store and trade routes, and he thinks a {{Color BotW|Red|Rito}} merchant would be perfect for the job.

Find a Rito with the know-how to manage a shop and the connections to set up trade, and of course, make sure {{Color BotW|Red|his or her name ends in "son."}} |- | 10 | A Rito by the name of Fyson has moved to Tarrey Town to run the general store.

Pay the town a visit to make sure he arrived safely, and check in with {{Color BotW|Red|Hudson}} while you're there. |- | 11 | Fyson arrived safely in Tarrey Town and put the experience he gained from running his family's shop to good use. He opened up a general store!

Hudson wants to build another batch of buildings, but he needs more material.

Bring him another {{Color BotW|Red|50 bundles of wood}}. |- | 12 | You brought Hudson enough wood!

And now, as it turns out, Hudson is engaged to Rhondson! Can you believe it?

They want to hold a ceremony, so he wants you to find a {{Color BotW|Red|Zora}} who can officiate. Even though this Zora technically won't be working for Hudson's company, he would be much more comfortable if the {{Color BotW|Red|Zora's name ended in "son."}} |- | 13 | A former Zora priest by the name of Kapson has moved to Tarrey Town!

Pay the town a visit to make sure he arrived safely and to see what other shenanigans {{Color BotW|Red|Hudson}} has been up to. There's always something going on with that guy! |- | 14 | Kapson, a Zora and former priest, arrived safely in Tarrey Town and began making preparations for the wedding ceremony.

Hudson wants to invite Bolson and Karson to his wedding but he's too busy with preparations of his own. Go to {{Color BotW|Red|Hateno Village}} to invite {{Color BotW|Red|Bolson and Karson}}. |- | 15 | Bolson and Karson departed for Tarrey Town.

All that's left now is to return to the town yourself and enjoy Hudson and Rhondson's wedding ceremony!

Head back to the town and look for {{Color BotW|Red|Hudson}}. |- | 16 | Hudson and Rhondson's wedding was a shining beacon in an otherwise dark, dangerous world.

Rhondson was a little taken aback by a few of the vows, but everything worked out fine and is in perfect compliance with Bolson Construction's guidelines.

It's only polite to give your blessing to the lovely couple who just vowed their undying love, so go talk to {{Color BotW|Red|Hudson}}. |- | Complete | Hudson and Rhondson are happily married, and Tarry Town is enjoying great prosperity.

As a sign of appreciation for bringing the town together and as compensation for your work, Hudson gave you a hefty amount of gems that were unearthed during the town's construction.

You wished the couple eternal happiness before heading on your way. }} ==Trivia== * After beginning this Side Quest, Link can ask several people in Akkala about Hudson's location. ** At [[East Akkala Stable]], [[Nobo]] will be unfamiliar with him,{{Cite|[You know Hudson?] Hudson? Who's that? He's a carpenter? I'm not quite sure...|Nobo|BotW}} but claims to have heard noises coming from Lake Akkala.{{Cite|I've been hearing clanging and banging by {{Color BotW|Blue|Lake Akkala}}. That's {{Color BotW|Red|south}} of here. Why don't you go check it out?|Nobo|BotW}} ** At [[South Akkala Stable]], [[Jana]] heard him say something about building a village at Lake Akkala.{{Cite|If you're looking for Hudson the {{Color BotW|Blue|carpenter}}... He said something about building a village {{Color BotW|Red|from the ground up}}. Then he headed off toward {{Color BotW|Blue|Lake Akkala}}. {{Color BotW|Blue|Lake Akkala}} is to the east of here. If you're curious, you should head over there.|Jana|BotW}} * While Link is searching for a Zora priest, he can approach [[Gaddison]], a guard for [[Zora's Domain]], about the position.{{Cite|Someone whose name ends with "son" who can also act as a priest...is what you seek?|Gaddison|BotW}} However, Gaddison will refuse him, as she is a soldier.{{Cite|I'm sorry, Master Link... I am a blood-stained soldier.
